verdict.line: You lose if you let Path Maker charge-stun pin you into a gank or tentacle-free corner; you win if you drag W (Harsh Lesson) and E (Test of Spirit) into every short trade K'Sante starts.

brief.thesis: Illaoi holds a 43.8% win rate over 32 games here but still carries the lane-advantage and solo-kill edge, because K'Sante's entire kit is a stance of shields and dashes with no sustained damage answer to a Vessel spiraling out of control. The matchup is decided by whether K'Sante can land his W (Path Maker) stun into a clean trade before you've put a spirit on him — once E (Test of Spirit) is out, every short all-in he takes echoes damage back and starts printing Tentacles.

tell.watch: K'Sante's Q stacks and W charge

theirWindow.what: He charges briefly then dashes to knock back and stun — if you're caught walking up without a Tentacle nearby, he gets a free stun-into-Q-into-auto sequence. Don't approach in a straight line when his W icon is lit.

yourWindow.when: His W (Path Maker) and R (All Out) are both down
yourWindow.what: Without W he has no stun and no reliable gap-close/escape beyond a single E (Footwork) dash. Walk him down, land E (Test of Spirit) to force the spirit fight, and follow with W (Harsh Lesson) leaps — he has nothing to punish the extended trade with.

start.why: Picked in 71.8% of games (50% win rate over 28) — the lifesteal and damage let you win extended Q (Tentacle Smash) and auto trades instead of getting poked out by his Q (Ntofo Strikes).

boots.why: 67.7% pick rate and the higher win rate (39.1% over 23 games) — his auto-reset trades and Q (Ntofo Strikes) procs are physical, so the flat reduction blunts every short engage he starts.

core.why: First in the most-run build path (36.8% pick, 57.1% win over 7 games) — stacks armor shred on your auto/W leaps, which matters since K'Sante stacks defensive items off his kit.
Second in the same path — the proc adds a free AoE burst on your W (Harsh Lesson) leap-ins and slows him so he can't kite your Tentacles.
Closes out the top build path (36.8% pick) — the HP and tenacity keep you alive through his R (All Out) burst window.

runes.keystoneWhy: Most-run page (38.5% pick, 53.3% win rate) — triggers on every W (Harsh Lesson) leap into him, and the sustain wins the slow 1v1 grind that this matchup actually is.

summoners.why: Highest pick rate at 66.7% (50% win over games run) — Teleport lets you reset the wave after trading and come back with a Tentacle advantage, since this matchup is won through repeated short trades rather than a single kill window.

playing.title: Hold E until he commits
playing.detail: Don't throw E (Test of Spirit) on cooldown — wait for him to walk up for a trade, land it mid-engage so the spirit forces extra damage back onto him during the exchange.

playing.title: Track his W charge visually
playing.detail: W (Path Maker) has a brief charge-up before the dash-stun; if you see him start charging, sidestep or back off rather than eating the knockback into your own Tentacles' range.

playing.title: Fight near your Tentacles
playing.detail: Passive Tentacles only swing near impassible terrain — stay near walls/jungle so every E (Test of Spirit) or W (Harsh Lesson) proc also triggers free Tentacle damage.

playing.title: Punish empty W cooldown
playing.detail: W (Path Maker) is 14/13/12/11/10s — once it's down, he has no stun and only E (Footwork) to escape. This is your window to force the all-in trade.

playing.title: Don't greed past his R threshold
playing.detail: R (All Out) knocks you through walls and transforms his kit into a bigger threat — recognize when he's level 6+ with R up and avoid overextending into a position where the knockback separates you from teammates.

playing.title: Use Teleport to reset tempo
playing.detail: After a short trade where you land E (Test of Spirit), teleport back post-recall to immediately resume pressure — this matchup rewards repeated short engagements over one long siege.

playing.title: Build Cleaver stacks early in fights
playing.detail: Black Cleaver's shred compounds on his already lower base resistances from All Out's defensive trade-off — prioritize landing autos between ability leaps to stack it before his cooldowns reset.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners and the 43.8% head-to-head win rate over 32 games are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1); the tactical reasoning — cooldown windows, Tentacle positioning, and trade timing — is my own analysis layered on top.
